name: Metamagic Rod, Stygian
body:
Price varies: lesser stygian metamagic rod 9,000 gp; stygian metamagic rod 32,500 gp; greater stygian metamagic rod 73,000 gp; Aura strong (no school) Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that suppress memories as though using the Stygian Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: lesser stygian metamagic rod 4,500 gp; stygian metamagic rod 16,250 gp; greater stygian metamagic rod 36,500 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Stygian Spell
